title: Retime two P104 ADD stars in a shared chart
body:
PR #2662 explicitly leaves ADDs as barriers in its fixed-frame endpoint-run class. This contribution closes one finite interface outside that class: two complete early ADD stars can execute in their shared ZERO chart, then take direct positive children to the original exit frames. Every affected field has the same physical value at its exit; all ADD coefficients/order, 358 public inputs/outputs, 150 dirty-helper restorations and eight owned zero/zero-erase lifetimes are retained.

The exact changes are two `H1+H1 -> H2`, one `H1+H4 -> H5` and one `H1+H6 -> H7`. The word has 1,938 transports and 5,266 events, down from 1,942 and 5,270, with unchanged rank mass 3,542 and 3,104 scalar ADDs. N33 and N34 still pay their line entries. Four ADD frame annotations change jointly, so #2662's scoped optimum is not contradicted. The local child moment strictly decreases for `0<p<1`; no favorable complete moment is claimed.

`research/p104-shared-chart-retiming/PROOF.md` supplies the dirty-input identity, literal source-use windows, positive-child formulas and cost boundary. The replay compares the full 358-by-358 coefficient boundary, all helpers and exact private erasures. Three native recipes cover four occurrences of ranks 2, 2, 7 and 5, with all 1,536 Gaussian columns, exact phase and signed Pauli checks. Nine failure controls, an equivalent-frame positive control, and five export/integrity groups cover the claimed interface. The native interpreter executes the exact authenticated source buffer, including an eligible stale-bytecode control credited to the existing #2553 boundary.

Sources are pinned to #2662 `b67542b2896c21106f3945673bbf5b6e131408cc` and #2586 `7953c9a8f788a8de5cf2ced63d9a61b67c22c6f1`, with SHA-256 and Git blobs. Unchanged native edges inherit those pending sources. The other 102 forward rows retain the predecessor's Gram/2 contract; this is not a fully corrected identity core. Whole-consumer scalar/address costs, monomial movement, owners/windows, hosting, idle/residual terms, precision/rounded erasure and all-size admission remain unknown. #2674's different-word precision bound is not transferred. Revision 5 decision: finish this finite interface, with no dependent optimization or family-expansion claim.

Validation: native CPython 3.12.7 registered optimized replay plus all five export/integrity groups pass; native 3.14.5 optimized primary passes. A separate agent's no-import audit independently reconstructed both full boundaries, the exact source edits and all 1,536 Gaussian columns. Final Git-byte/export binding is recorded in the delivery receipts. Reproduce with:

```text
python -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-shared-chart-retiming
```

Credit commdata2338 for #2662 and its explicit ADD-barrier handoff, ywz65 for #2586/#2497/#2551, Nick Petalas for #2550 and the retained predecessor lineage. Common-chart linearity and the C-inverse identity are standard. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. No independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed.
